name: Barb Clementi

summary.text: Barb Clementi is a retired teacher who served two terms on the Pueblo School District 60 Board of Education, including as board president, from 2015 to 2023.

experience.text: Pueblo School District 60 Board of Education, two terms (2015-2023), including two years as vice president and two years as president.
Taught in Pueblo schools for close to 30 years.
Represented Colorado educators on the National Education Association Board of Directors and served as president of the Colorado Association of School Boards.

education_focus.text: Clementi says the state should fully fund and implement the updated School Finance Act and regularly review the rural-district funding allotment.
On homeschool enrichment programs, she says the concept 'has been seriously abused over the last ten years' to fund private and religious education, and that 'public funds belong in public schools.'
Her campaign site says public education dollars 'should stay in public schools and serve their public purpose, not flow through loopholes to private or religious institutions.'
